notes.title: Folian Mac Public Beta 12
items: Draft chapters, sections, scenes and passages with more dependable autosave, manual save, paragraph spacing and recovery after a failed save.
Use the Professional Editor to review a passage or selection, revise from a saved Review, edit proposed wording, accept the changes you want and apply them to the manuscript.
Return to editorial History and open issues. Answer a question into Decisions, add a revision target or send a factual concern to Research.
Plan with project-aware Story Map threads, beats and supporting points, then review their placement alongside your manuscript.
Keep Research sources and verification separate from established project facts. Nonfiction editing protects uncertainty and rejects unsupported factual additions.
Choose current GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna models or supported GPT-5.6 alternatives when your connected provider offers them.
Find clearer first-session help and task-focused guides from the workspace.

notes.title: Folian Beta 0.10
items: Switch between Standard and Focused Writing from the manuscript toolbar.
Keep the manuscript central while real project context and optional Folian intelligence remain available beside it.
Move through chapters and scenes without leaving the focused view.
Use Ask, Memory, Editorial and History from an independently scrollable context panel.
Open project context as an accessible drawer on smaller windows and mobile Studio layouts.
Return quickly to Chapters, Editing or Progress when broader project work is needed.
Retain each project's preferred writing view and context-panel state on the current device.
Use Folian without AI; Memory and project records remain available when no provider is connected.
Use the native View → Focused Writing command on desktop.
Benefit from shared behavior and terminology across Folian Desktop and Folian Studio.
Focused Writing preferences are device-specific rather than synchronized between devices.
Desktop filesystem tools and updates remain desktop-only. Authentication and cloud persistence remain Studio-only.

notes.title: Folian Beta 9
items: Existing projects now appear first when Folian opens.
The most recently used project is highlighted under Continue writing.
Other projects appear in a clearer Recent projects section.
New-project setup stays collapsed until you choose to create another project.
About Folian now provides a clearer Beta 9 version reference.

notes.title: Folian beta 8
items: Adds a native Check for Updates command to the Folian application menu.
Reports the installed release as up to date without downloading the same version again.
Makes update checking, availability, download and failure states clearer.
Refines AI model choices into recommended, advanced and older supported groups.
Adds independent local and GitHub download verification for release artifacts.

notes.title: Folian paid beta release candidate
items: Uses config.folian.app for desktop update discovery and the remote AI model catalogue.
Adds verified current and older supported AI model choices.
Keeps the stable desktop channel inactive until a real stable release is promoted.
Protects partial project setting updates from clearing omitted fields.
Preserves local projects, encrypted API keys, exports and backups during application updates.

notes.title: Folian beta foundation
items: Desktop-local writing project storage.
Structured project setup, manuscript editing, research and export workflows.
Remote model catalogue foundation.
